MessData.title: Mess Data Document
MessData.description: Represents the full state of a shared mess including members, configuration, meals, and transactions

updatedBy.description: Client instance ID that updated the record

members.description: List of active mess member names

config.description: Mess configuration such as name, month, fixed costs, and admin password hash

meals.description: Daily meal counts indexed by date string YYYY-MM-DD

transactions.description: Chronological records of money deposits and market expenses

/messes_v3/{messKey}/data/main.description: Main state document for a shared mess identified by encoded key
